title: MIRA: Evidence-Verified Repair Memory for Text-to-SQL Correction

live_model.evidence: "All stages that use a general-purpose correction LLM employ gpt-5-2025-08-07" (Sec 4.1); Table 1 overall EX: MIRA=76.92% vs Current SQL=63.31% (n=1,785)

prompt.note: Sec 2/4 describe corrector inputs (question, schema, current SQL, historical memory items) narratively; no prompt text is quoted and the paper has no appendix.

claim.location: Table 1, Overall EX column, row MIRA; n = 1,785 test cases across 6 benchmark/upstream-system combinations

data.source: BIRD Mini-Dev (corrected, Jin et al.) and ScienceBenchmark (public Text-to-SQL benchmarks)

notes: Paper reports exact call/token counts for gpt-5-2025-08-07 (4,779 calls, 13.71M in / 6.12M out tokens over all 1,785 inputs) but never quotes the corrector prompt. All five comparator methods (MAGIC, TK-Boost, SQLFixAgent, SHARE, Current SQL) use the same gpt-5-2025-08-07 correction LLM and share this gap.
